scripts.server:dev: cd server && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000
scripts.server:migrate: cd server && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.server:seed: cd server && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.server:lint: cd server && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run server:lint
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run server:test
